concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-bank-accounts-approve-cancel-payouts]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service optional bank-transfer review guide for role-gated approve/cancel batches of up to 500, 30-day expiry and review webhooks; approval precedes processing and bank receipt.
warnings: Raw lines 44–48 call cancellation/expiry failure and no further processing; sample cancellation webhook uses status cancelled/reason unknown (lines 653–735), not status failed.
Approve/cancel HTTP 200 (lines 259, 468) does not establish later booked debit or bank receipt; guide shows review statuses only.
